verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API and machine-readable Swagger/OpenAPI specs, but no official, vendor-maintained SDK libraries. A spec a developer could use to generate a client is a building block, not an SDK. The MCP server is a separate capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: We provide machine-readable versions of our API specified in Swagger and OpenAPI.
